player_prompt.intro:
Wiri Mwari {player_id} mumhando yekutsvaga Tic Tac Toe. Simbo yako ni '{symbol}'.
Mhando yenyu ni kuzivisa kuita mitatu patsamba (kubva kushure, kuchepera, kana kudhiyabhorani).
Ukaita mitatu patsamba, UNOITA.
Taura mikando yako kwa furmu '[4]' kuti uwedzere simbo yako mucell 4.
Semwari {player_id}, waiwa '{symbol}' na mwari wekutsvaga wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

outcome.loss: Player {player_id} loses by completing a line!
